evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection establishment and address binding in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
rationale: Adds the `-outboundbind` configuration option to allow multi-homed nodes to select their local outgoing source IP address. This addresses long-standing issue #6476 ('Does not use bind to local address for outgoing connections'), providing clear utility for specific network configurations while remaining reasonably deferrable.
